title: OpenAI Will Provide Free AI Models To Select Researchers
excerpt: The program, ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, will start with 10,000 participants this summer.
content_html:
The program, ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, will start with 10,000 participants this summer.

Samuel Boivin/Shutterstock

OpenAI is launching a new program called ChatGPT for Academic Researchers that will offer free access to the company's AI models to 100,000 scientists, mathematicians and engineers. Researchers from "select academic institutions" included in the program will receive hands-on support from OpenAI, access to the company's latest GPT-5.6 Sol Pro model and be able to invite four collaborators from their institution to participate.

The program will start with 10,000 participants this summer and scale up to 100,000 through 2027. OpenAI says offering free access to its AI tools "is part of a commitment of more than $250 million through 2027 to support external scientific research and discovery." As the company notes, researchers are already using AI models to sift through data and write grants — this just makes the relationship a bit more formal. OpenAI's version of ChatGPT for schools, ChatGPT Edu, follows a similar logic.

While the least charitable read of the program is that OpenAI is looking for new sources of training data, the company says that by default, researchers' data will not be used to train models. What handing out freebies to research institutions could generate, though, is more research breakthroughs that in some way involved a GPT model. And making more scientific fields dependent on the company's tools could also pave the way for future revenue from for-profit research.

This isn't the first time the company has courted researchers. OpenAI introduced Prism in January, an AI-powered tool for working with scientific journals and documents. Prism is available to anyone with a ChatGPT account and can be used to verify things like research citations and formatting. OpenAI's early demo of the tool also included a way to generate lesson plans, one of the more tedious but critical tasks of research professors.

content_html_zh:
ChatGPT 学术研究人员计划将于今年夏天启动，共有 10,000 名参与者。

塞缪尔·博伊文/Shutterstock

OpenAI 正在为学术研究人员推出一项名为 ChatGPT 的新计划，该计划将为 10 万名科学家、数学家和工程师提供免费访问该公司人工智能模型的机会。 该计划中的“精选学术机构”的研究人员将获得 OpenAI 的实践支持，访问该公司最新的 GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 模型，并能够邀请其机构的四名合作者参与。

该计划将于今年夏天启动，参与者人数为 10,000 人，到 2027 年将扩大到 100,000 人。 OpenAI 表示，免费提供其人工智能工具“是到 2027 年投入超过 2.5 亿美元支持外部科学研究和发现的承诺的一部分”。 正如该公司指出的那样，研究人员已经在使用人工智能模型来筛选数据并撰写资助——这只会让这种关系更加正式。 OpenAI 的学校 ChatGPT 版本 ChatGPT Edu 也遵循类似的逻辑。

虽然该计划最不友善的解读是 OpenAI 正在寻找新的训练数据来源，但该公司表示，默认情况下，研究人员的数据不会用于训练模型。 不过，向研究机构免费赠送可能会产生更多在某种程度上涉及 GPT 模型的研究突破。 让更多科学领域依赖于该公司的工具也可以为营利性研究的未来收入铺平道路。

这并不是该公司第一次向研究人员求爱。 OpenAI 在 1 月份推出了 Prism，这是一款由人工智能驱动的工具，用于处理科学期刊和文档。 Prism 可供拥有 ChatGPT 帐户的任何人使用，并可用于验证研究引文和格式等内容。 OpenAI 的该工具的早期演示还包括一种生成课程计划的方法，这是研究教授较为乏味但关键的任务之一。
